scenarios.name: baseline
scenarios.reason: Ordinary trading: a central warehouse with ample stock and accounts with ample funds.

scenarios.name: limited-stock
scenarios.reason: A small store keeps a dozen units of each item, just above the 10 to 11 units a tenant's orders take.

scenarios.name: tight-budget
scenarios.reason: Prepaid accounts topped up with about a tenth more than the usual orders cost (2982), not enough for prices a quarter higher.

scenarios.name: strict-timeout
scenarios.reason: A mobile checkout keeps requests short, so orders gives each call to its dependencies 0.3 s.

scenarios.name: clearance-sale
scenarios.reason: A clearance sale offers only items whose number ends in 7, which pricing discounts.

scenarios.name: bulk-orders
scenarios.reason: Wholesale customers order cases of five and ten units, within the gateway's limit of ten.

scenarios.name: fresh-prices
scenarios.reason: While prices are being changed, orders may keep a unit price in its cache for one second only.
